name: refrigerator_freezer_r134a
title: Domestic refrigerator-freezer on R134a with two evaporators
summary: Sizing of a domestic fridge-freezer on R134a delivering 1.5 kW of refrigeration at two evaporation temperatures (3 °C for the fridge compartment, -20 °C for the freezer) with one high and two low pressures: computes the compressor outlet temperature, the refrigerant flow rate, the compressor power, the condenser duty and the volumetric flow rates entering the two expansion valves.

origin.course: ULiège, Thermodynamique appliquée (MECA0002), repetition session 8, exercise 3

verification.reference: Solution stored in the source EES file (converted from its kPa/kJ unit system); independently cross-checked with the Python/CoolProp solution of the same exercise of the 2020 session (~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/thermodynamique appliquee/2022-2023/R8/old/ThAp20_R08E03.py)
verification.notes: Main file vs EES: 55 common variables, 17 differ (rtol=1e-3). 15 absolute enthalpies/entropies differ by constant EES-vs-CoolProp R134a reference-state offsets (+148.15 kJ/kg on h, +795.65 J/kg-K on s); V_dot_3/V_dot_5 are reported in m3/s instead of L/s (factor 1000, same numbers). Largest relative deviation over all the other variables: 7.5e-4 (v[5]), within the 0.5 % property tolerance. P and Pertes (in the EES variable records but in no equation) are not part of the model.
